verdict.rationale: Jira's Rovo AI is documented as a built-in assistant that can break down big ideas into tasks, auto-assign them, create automations, and surface trends, which matches the delegate-to-AI-assistant story, but all evidence is vendor marketing copy with no independent or hands-on confirmation of how well this delegation actually works. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Rovo AI task delegation, community feedback specifically on Rovo AI's reliability, and detail on scope/limits of delegated actions.
